description: Each media type's rate is its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds; list the media types whose rate is above the unweighted mean of all media types' rates, with the rate and how far above it is.

b.request: Among media types with at least one track, compute each type's rate as SUM(Track.Bytes) / SUM(Track.Milliseconds) over its tracks, and return the name, unrounded rate, and unrounded excess over the unweighted average of all per-type rates, for types whose rate is strictly greater than that average
b.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS excess FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate;

c.request: Which media types (by name, counting only tracks that have a media type) have a bytes-per-millisecond rate higher than the simple average of that rate across all media types? For each, show the media type name, its rate, and how much it exceeds that average, unrounded. Each media type's rate is its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds; list the media types whose rate is above the unweighted mean of all media types' rates, with the rate and how far above it is.
c.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS Rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(Rate) AS AvgRate FROM rates) SELECT r.MediaTypeName, r.Rate, r.Rate - a.AvgRate AS ExceedsBy FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.Rate > a.AvgRate ORDER BY ExceedsBy DESC;

a.request: For each media type (grouped by name, using only tracks that are linked to a media type), compute its byte rate as the media type's total `Bytes` divided by its total `Milliseconds`. Then take the simple average of these rates across all media types. Which media types have a rate above that overall average? For each, give the media type name, its rate, and how far it is above the overall average (rate minus average), without rounding.
a.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ByteRate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(ByteRate) AS AvgRate FROM rates) SELECT r.MediaTypeName, r.ByteRate, r.ByteRate - a.AvgRate AS AboveAverageBy FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.ByteRate > a.AvgRate;

d.request: Among media types that have at least one track with a media type, which ones have a bytes-per-millisecond rate (total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds) above the unweighted mean of all media types' rates? For each, show the media type name, its rate, and how far it exceeds that mean, unrounded.
d.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT mr.Name AS MediaTypeName, mr.rate AS BytesPerMs, mr.rate - m.avg_rate AS ExceedsMeanBy FROM media_rates mr CROSS JOIN mean_rate m WHERE mr.rate > m.avg_rate;
